newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian protesters besiege police station.
newsitem.headline: Albanian protesters besiege police station.

text.p: Up to 10,000 protesters besieged the main police station in this port city on Thursday to demand the release of comrades they said were detained in an earlier rally against collapsed pyramid investment schemes.

"Free our friends," shouted the protesters, massed in the street and on nearby rooftops. Riot police guarding the building crouched or raised their shields to protect themselves against a hail of stones.
A group of several hundred protesters tried to rush into the building at one point but was repulsed.
A police commander told reporters a number of demonstrators detained after pitched street battles throughout Wednesday had been released after questioning.

The official ATA news agency reported that an unspecified number of "terrorists" had been arrested. More than 150 people were detained after violent protests against the failed pyramid schemes last month and face long jail terms if convicted.

Crowds of up to 30,000 had marched throughout Vlore earlier on Thursday after brushing past token police lines. The demonstration was sparked by the collapse of one pyramid scheme particularly popular in the south of the Balkan country.
